subject: spanish
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in Spanish on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (Spanish↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.explain: “El ayuntamiento” means “the town hall”, the local council building.

questions.q: What does “el equipaje de mano” mean?
questions.explain: “El equipaje” = luggage and “de mano” = hand, so “el equipaje de mano” = “hand luggage”.

questions.q: How do you say “We stayed in a campsite by the sea”?
options: Nos alojamos en un hotel junto al mar
Nos alojamos en un camping junto al mar
Nos alojamos en un camping junto a la montaña
Os alojasteis en un camping junto al mar
questions.explain: “Nos alojamos” = “we stayed”, “un camping” = campsite and “junto al mar” = by the sea.

questions.q: What does “al extranjero” mean in “viajar al extranjero”?
questions.explain: “El extranjero” means “abroad / foreign country”, so “viajar al extranjero” = “to travel abroad”.

questions.q: What does 'el billete de ida y vuelta' mean?
questions.explain: 'Ida y vuelta' means 'there and back', so 'el billete de ida y vuelta' = 'a return ticket'.

questions.q: Which sentence means “I have to change trains in Madrid”?
options: Tengo que perder el tren en Madrid
Tengo que coger el tren a Madrid
Tengo que hacer transbordo en Madrid
Tengo que cambiar dinero en Madrid
questions.explain: “Hacer transbordo” means “to change (trains/buses)”, so the first option is correct.
“Las afueras” means “the outskirts” of a town, where many people live.

questions.q: How do you say 'I spent two weeks on the coast'?
options: Pasé dos semanas en la montaña
Pasaré dos semanas en la costa
Pasé dos semanas en la costa
Paso dos semanas en la costa
questions.explain: 'Pasé' is the preterite 'I spent' and 'la costa' = 'the coast', so the first option is correct.

questions.q: How do you say “I have lived here for ten years”?
options: Vivía aquí desde hace diez años
Vivo aquí desde hace diez años
Voy a vivir aquí diez años
questions.explain: For an action continuing into the present, Spanish uses the present + “desde hace”: “Vivo aquí desde hace diez años”.

questions.q: How do you say 'I would like to book a double room'?
options: Me gustaría reservar una habitación individual
Me gustaría recordar una habitación doble
Me gustaría reservar una habitación doble
Me gusta reservar una habitación doble
questions.explain: 'Reservar' = 'to book' and 'doble' = 'double'; 'recordar' (to remember) is a near-miss distractor.

questions.q: Which means “I'd recommend visiting the old town”?
questions.explain: “El casco antiguo” means “the old town”, and “recomendaría” is the conditional “I'd recommend”.
'Hacer turismo' means 'to go sightseeing / do tourism'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I live in a quiet neighbourhood'?
questions.explain: 'El barrio' is masculine, so 'tranquilo' agrees; 'vivo' is the correct first-person form.
